version: '1'
kind: miner
id: 0
slug: truth-onchain-pinned-account
protocol: generic
name: Pinned native account truth
description: Free evaluation-only native balance and nonce source on ethereum, polygon
  and arbitrum. Every success requires fresh exact canonical-hash state agreement
  at Nodies+dRPC (Ethereum), PublicNode+dRPC (Polygon) or PublicNode+Nodies (Arbitrum).
  No cached data, latest substitution or cryptographic proof. Public archive availability
  is limited; unavailable blocks fail closed.
base_url: https://telegraph-s2-hashprice.margyn.workers.dev/truth/v1
auth:
  type: none
cache_ttl_sec: 0
rate_limit_per_sec: 1
circuit_threshold: 3
circuit_cooldown_seconds: 60
input_schema:
  type: object
  required:
  - address
  - block
  additionalProperties: false
  properties:
    address:
      type: string
      pattern: ^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$
    block:
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      maximum: 1000000000000
    chain:
      type: string
      enum:
      - ethereum
      - polygon
      - arbitrum
      default: ethereum
    metric:
      type: string
      enum:
      - balance
      - tx_count
      default: balance
output_schema:
  type: object
  required:
  - balance_gwei
  - address
  - block
  - chain
  - tx_count
  properties:
    balance_gwei:
      type: number
      minimum: 0
      maximum: 100000000000000000000
    address:
      type: string
    block:
      type: string
    chain:
      type: string
      enum:
      - ethereum
      - polygon
      - arbitrum
      default: ethereum
    tx_count:
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      maximum: 1000000000000
errors:
  message_path: error
  code_path: code
endpoints:
- path: /balance
  external_path: /balance
  method: GET
  description: Read native balance and account nonce at the exact requested block.
    Both values are always returned, including when metric is tx_count. HTTP 400 rejects
    malformed selectors. HTTP 502 refuses unavailable, inconsistent or timed-out RPC
    evidence. This is a free evaluator source, not a paid data resale service.
  intents:
  - ONCHAIN_METRIC_VERIFY_GENERAL
  params:
    query:
      required:
      - name: address
        type: string
        intents:
        - '*'
        description: Exact 20-byte 0x hexadecimal address. Never resolve a label.
      - name: block
        type: integer
        intents:
        - '*'
        description: Exact requested integer height 0 through 1000000000000. Never
          latest or another block.
      optional:
      - name: chain
        type: string
        intents:
        - '*'
        description: ethereum, polygon or arbitrum. Default ethereum only when omitted.
      - name: metric
        type: string
        intents:
        - '*'
        description: balance or tx_count. Default balance. tx_count is account nonce,
          not transfers.
semantics:
  supported_intents:
  - ONCHAIN_METRIC_VERIFY_GENERAL
  signal_mapping:
    label_field: summary
    reason_field: summary
intent_mapping:
  ONCHAIN_METRIC_VERIFY_GENERAL:
    endpoint: /balance
    input:
      address:
        from: address
        how: Exact 20-byte 0x hexadecimal address. Never resolve a label.
      block:
        from: block
        how: Exact requested integer height 0 through 1000000000000. Never latest
          or another block.
      chain:
        from: chain
        how: ethereum, polygon or arbitrum. Default ethereum only when omitted.
      metric:
        from: metric
        how: balance or tx_count. Default balance. tx_count is account nonce, not
          transfers.
    output:
      balance_gwei:
        path: balance_gwei
        unit: Gwei
      address:
        path: address
      block:
        path: block
      chain:
        path: chain
      tx_count:
        path: tx_count
